scientific_integrity.computational_check: Standard-library exact rational checker passed 228 parameter evaluations and generator/derivative/extremizer identities.
scientific_integrity.core_proof: Stationary conditional Fourier and generator equations give second/fourth moments; inverse-rate moment inequalities yield negative first and positive second refresh derivatives; a bounded-variable quadratic inequality yields the sharp support envelope.
scientific_integrity.limitations: Brownian position in one spatial dimension; autonomous positive-frequency Poisson redraws of nonnegative finite intensity, with particle resets retaining intensity; one-time stationarity only. Inference requires the intensity law known. The general Fourier law is previously published and independently obtainable moment formulas are not claimed new.
scientific_integrity.scientific_priority_risk: The prior exact Fourier transform logically determines all stationary moments; the strict normalized shape comparison and sharp envelope may also have unindexed equivalents. No independent validation.

title: Sharp kurtosis envelope and refresh-clock calibration for Brownian diffusion with random resetting intensity
